CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

4. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

7. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Photography.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

10. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

14. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
